description: RAG pipeline — retrieve, (optional) rerank, generate. Two shapes: (1) legacy monolithic (embed → retrieve → generate hardcoded to chromadb/pinecone + openai/anthropic) — set `vector_store_provider`+`collection_name`+`llm_provider`+`llm_model`. (2) Ops mode (opt-in via `steps:`) — chain of named ops (`retrieve` / `hybrid_search` / `rerank` / `expand_query` / `generate`) with reusable `personas:` / `retrievers:` / `rerankers:` blocks, LiteLLM for generation, Voyage/Cohere reranking, BM25+vector hybrid search via RRF, HyDE query expansion, and reasoning + prompt caching support.

personas.label: Personas
personas.description: Ops mode only. Named reusable LLM sub-configs. Each entry: `{provider, model, api_key_env_var, api_base_env_var, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, reasoning_effort, thinking_budget, prompt_caching}`. Reference from any step via `persona: <name>`; explicit inline fields ALWAYS win. Applies to `generate`, `expand_query`, `refine` ops.

retrievers.label: Retrievers
retrievers.description: Ops mode only. Named reusable vector-store configs. Each: `{kind: chromadb|pinecone|qdrant|pgvector|weaviate, collection_name / index_name / table, path / url_env_var, embedding: {provider, model, api_key_env_var}}`. Reference from `retrieve` / `hybrid_search` steps via `retriever: <name>`.

rerankers.label: Rerankers
rerankers.description: Ops mode only. Named reusable reranker configs. Each: `{provider: voyage|cohere, model, api_key_env_var}`. Reference from `rerank` steps via `reranker: <name>`. Voyage rerank-2.5 and Cohere rerank-3.5 both supported.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Opt-in ops-based mode. When set, replaces the legacy monolithic behavior with a chain of named ops. Each: `{id, op, ...op-specific}`. Supported ops: `retrieve` (vector search), `hybrid_search` (BM25 + vector via RRF), `rerank` (Voyage/Cohere reranker over prior-step docs), `expand_query` (HyDE — LLM writes a hypothetical answer to embed), `generate` (final answer using retrieved docs). Steps read from prior steps via `source: <id>` (docs), `query_source: <id>` (query text), or default to most recent. Every op supports `persona: <name>` where applicable.

query_prompt_template.label: Query Prompt Template
query_prompt_template.description: Ops mode only. Template applied to `query_column` values before the first step. Placeholders: `{query}`, `{partition_key}`, `{partition.<name>}`. Leave unset to pass through unchanged.

sources_column.label: Sources Column
sources_column.description: Column name for retrieved source documents

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream input columns it derives from, e.g. {"revenue": ["price", "quantity"]}.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with query text

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: RAG Pipeline
